mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) as the wire serialisation format. It was chosen for its more standardised specification and for fewer version-compatibility concerns.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md
